COMMENT: A V4 Miniscope plus one behavior camera - the usual freely-moving setup.
COMMENT2: Keys containing 'COMMENT' are ignored by the software. Reference-AllOptions.json documents every available key.
COMMENT_dataDirectory: Where recordings are written. './Data' is relative to the software folder so this config runs as-is; for real experiments set an absolute path with forward slashes, e.g. 'D:/MiniscopeData'.
COMMENT_deviceIDs: The deviceIDs below are a guess. Use 'Scan devices...' in the Devices section to see which ID is the Miniscope and which is the behavior camera.

Miniscope.COMMENT_compression: Imaging data must stay lossless: FFV1 (lossless, uses CPU) or GREY (no compression, largest files).

BehaviorCam.COMMENT_deviceType: 'WebCam' uses the camera's default resolution; WebCam-320x240 / WebCam-640x480 / WebCam-1280x720 force one. Add your own entry to deviceConfigs/videoDevices.json for other resolutions.
BehaviorCam.COMMENT_compression: Lossy compression is fine for behavior video - MJPG is the safe default, XVID gives smaller files.
